description: This file declares functions related to autocasting within the Torch JIT compiler, including enabling/disabling autocast mode and applying autocast to a computation graph.

methods.name: Autocast
methods.description: Applies autocast transformations to the provided Torch JIT graph.

methods.name: setAutocastMode
methods.description: Enables or disables autocast mode based on the boolean value provided.

methods.name: autocastEnabled
methods.description: Checks if autocast mode is currently enabled.
